coverage.method: Entry uses first available yes_ask in an 8-hour window before market close. Limit exit uses max yes_bid, which is more conservative than max traded price.
coverage.feeAssumption: Fee-adjusted rows conservatively use taker fees on both entry and limit exit. Resting limit sells may be cheaper depending on the live fee tier/market.
